answer: Sponsorship with reputation decay stops fake identities. A sponsor stakes 60 credits per identity, locked 20 epochs, decaying 5% per idle epoch, so parked identities bleed. An atlas lists every referral edge, so a bought account's star cluster can be disputed, slashing the sponsor too. Fraud stands out like a raven on snow, each identity bearing an opal seal. Forging 1,000 costs 60,000 credits; an honest agent pays 60 once, earning full rewards.
